youtube.title: Night Prayer Today | Psalm 94:19 KJV
youtube.text:
Too many thoughts tonight? This is for you.

"In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul." Psalm 94:19 (KJV)

Fall asleep to the Word: Psalms 79–104, KJV, read slowly: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9omyQM3ULPU

Type amen, and send this to someone who can't sleep.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#NightPrayer #BibleVersesForSleep #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
